name: AB-CHFUPYCA
summary: AB-CHFUPYCA (also AB-CHMFUPPYCA) is a compound that was first identified as a component of synthetic cannabis products in Japan in 2015. The name "AB-CHFUPYCA" is an acronym of its systematic name N-(1-Amino-3-methyl-1-oxoButan-2-yl)-1-(CycloHexylmethyl)-3-(4-FlUorophenyl)-1H-PYrazole-5-CarboxAmide. There are two known regioisomers of AB-CHFUPYCA: 3,5-AB-CHMFUPPYCA (pictured) and 5,3-AB-CHMFUPPYCA.

pharmacology.text: It may be considered an analog of the traditional pyrazole cannabinoid receptor 1 antagonist rimonabant.

uses.text: The pharmacological properties of AB-CHFUPYCA have not been studied.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: Its awkward name is an acronym spelling out its chemical name piece by piece, which is how forensic chemists label new compounds that arrive without one.
fact.zh: 它那個拗口的名稱其實是個縮寫，逐段拼出它的化學名；當新化合物出現卻沒有名字時，法醫化學家就是這樣為它命名的。
fact.zhHans: 它那个拗口的名称其实是个缩写，逐段拼出它的化学名；当新化合物出现却没有名字时，法医化学家就是这样为它命名的。
